## History

Fred Wright was a model young man who owned a fine farm. He began a romantic relationship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and the two were later found together in the garden when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) confided her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Fred eventually married, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assisting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in the preparations for their wedding ceremony.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P6](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P7](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0007), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P9](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0009), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P12](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0012), +17 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred Wright and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) are romantically involved and engaged to be married. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers the pair together in a garden, after which [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide the news of their engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P6](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), +23 more_

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred Wright and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are comrades who work together as canvassing partners for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048)_
